title: 第五章 活阎王动怒
novel_title: 坟头开铺，我靠守墓重整阴阳两界
content_zh:
归墟峰常年不见日光。

    山体倒悬在幽冥渊最深处，黑石殿浮在浓雾里，殿外鬼灯一盏接一盏延伸到深处。低阶役煞跪伏在石阶两侧，连呼吸都不敢重。

    谢无咎站在殿中，掌心托着裂开的渊主令。

    宋砚站在阶下，声音平稳。

    “渊胎最后完整气息在城北梁家祖坟。渊印被人为刮毁，魂火被安魂符强行稳住，现落入槐荫坡守墓人沈清萝的引魂铃。”

    谢无咎垂眸：“玄司的人？”

    “是。墓籍堂在册守墓人，通灵下阶，无宗门，无白道师承。”

    宋砚顿了顿，补充道：“靠守墓、迁坟、写买地券为生。近期缺钱，接了梁家急单，是为了给养父迁坟。”

    谢无咎抬眼看他。

    “我问她来历，没问她穷不穷。”

    宋砚低头。

    “属下以为，她接触渊胎未必是故意。”

    谢无咎冷笑。

    “不是故意，就能碰幽冥渊的东西？”

    殿外忽然传来脚步声。

    一个六十来岁的妇人拎着竹篮走进来，围裙还没解，鬓边夹着一支木簪，手里端着一盅药膳。

    她一进来，殿里的役煞们反倒比见了谢无咎还紧张。

    “少爷。”

    柳嬷嬷把药膳放到案上。

    “动气归动气，药得喝。”

    谢无咎皱眉：“无味。”

    “您吃什么有味？”

    柳嬷嬷把勺子塞进他手里。

    “没味也得喝。归墟峰煞气这么重，您天天拿自己当镇山石用，真以为身子是铁打的？”

    谢无咎没动。

    柳嬷嬷看一眼渊主令裂纹，又看向宋砚。

    “渊胎出事了？”

    宋砚：“是。”

    “在人间？”

    “槐荫坡。”

    柳嬷嬷思索了一下：“守墓人住的地方？”

    宋砚点头。

    柳嬷嬷立刻看向谢无咎。

    “少爷，玄司在册守墓人不能随便动。您要去问可以，别一进门就拆人家院子。”

    谢无咎冷声：“我何时滥杀？”

    柳嬷嬷：“您是不滥杀，您只是脸一冷就像要灭满门。”

    宋砚低头。

    殿中低阶役煞更是恨不得把脑袋埋进石板里。

    谢无咎面无表情：“嬷嬷。”

    柳嬷嬷毫不畏惧。

    “叫嬷嬷也没用。您三百年不往人间走，一出去就带着这张讨债脸，别说小姑娘，鬼都要吓哭。”

    谢无咎：“我是去取渊胎。”

    柳嬷嬷：“那也得好好说话。”

    宋砚忍了忍，还是低声道：“嬷嬷，渊主不是去相看。”

    柳嬷嬷瞥他。

    “那也不妨碍他有点活人样。”

    谢无咎将药勺放下。

    “劫煞将。”

    黑雾在殿外聚成人形，高大煞将单膝跪地。

    “随我去槐荫坡。”

    柳嬷嬷一把拎起竹篮。

    “我也去。”

    谢无咎皱眉：“不必。”

    “怎么不必？您若把人家小姑娘吓坏了，总得有人收场。”

    谢无咎：“……”

    宋砚非常谨慎地没抬头。

    谢无咎最终只冷冷丢下一句：“你慢些。”

    柳嬷嬷满意了。

    “知道了。少爷，见了人家姑娘，别张口就是死不死、杀不杀。您年纪不小了。”
content_en:
Guixu Peak never sees sunlight all year round.

    The mountain hangs upside down in the deepest part of the Netherworld Abyss, the Black Stone Palace floats in thick fog, and the ghost lights outside the palace extend into the depths one after another. The low-level servants knelt on both sides of the stone steps, not even daring to breathe heavily.

    Xie Wujiu stood in the palace, holding the cracked Abyss Lord's Order in his palm.

    Song Yan stood at the foot of the steps, his voice steady.

    "The last complete breath of Yuan Ti was in the ancestral grave of the Liang family in the north of the city. The Yuan seal was artificially scraped off, and the soul fire was forcibly stabilized by the requiem talisman. Now it falls into the soul-inducing bell of Shen Qingluo, the tomb keeper of Huaiyinpo."

    Xie Wujiu lowered his eyes: "People from Xuan Si?"

    "Yes. The tomb keeper is registered in the tomb hall. He is a lower-level psychic. He has no sect and no Bai Dao disciple."

    Song Yan paused and added: "I make a living by guarding tombs, moving tombs, and writing land purchase certificates. I have been short of money recently, so I took an urgent order from the Liang family to move the tomb of my adoptive father."

    Xie Wujiu raised his eyes to look at him.

    "I asked her where she was from, but I didn't ask her if she was poor."

    Song Yan lowered his head.

    "My subordinates believe that her contact with Yuan Fei may not be intentional."

    Xie Wujiu sneered.

    "You can touch things in Netherworld Abyss without doing it intentionally?"

    Suddenly there were footsteps outside the hall.

    A woman in her sixties walked in carrying a bamboo basket, her apron still untied, a wooden hairpin on her temples, and a cup of medicinal food in her hand.

    As soon as she came in, the servants in the palace were even more nervous than when they met Xie Wu Jiu.

    "Master."

    Aunt Liu put the medicinal food on the table.

    "If you are angry, you must drink the medicine."

    Xie Wujiu frowned: "It's tasteless."

    "What do you eat that tastes good?"

    Aunt Liu put the spoon into his hand.

    "You have to drink it even if it doesn't taste good. The evil spirit of Guixu Peak is so strong. You use yourself as a rock to stabilize the mountain every day. Do you really think your body is made of iron?"

    Xie Wujiu didn't move.

    Aunt Liu glanced at Yuanzhu Lingcrack, and then looked at Song Yan.

    "Something happened to Yuan Tai?"

    Song Yan: "Yes."

    "In the human world?"

    "Huaiyin Slope."

    Aunt Liu thought for a moment: "Where does the tomb keeper live?"

    Song Yan nodded.

    Aunt Liu immediately looked at Xie Wujiu.

    "Master, Xuan Si is not allowed to touch the tomb keeper casually. You have to go and ask if you can. Don't tear down the courtyard as soon as you enter."

    Xie Wujiu said coldly: "When will I kill indiscriminately?"

    Aunt Liu: "You don't kill indiscriminately, you just look cold as if you want to wipe out the whole family."

    Song Yan lowered his head.

    The low-ranking servants in the palace wanted to bury their heads in the stone slab.

    Xie Wujiu said expressionlessly: "Mom."

    Aunt Liu was not afraid.

    "It's no use calling me mama. You won't go to the world for three hundred years, and when you go out, you will look like a debt collector. Not to mention the little girl, ghosts will make you cry."

    Xie Wujiu: "I'm going to get the Yuan Fei."

    Aunt Liu: "Then you have to talk nicely."

    Song Yan endured it and said in a low voice: "Mommy, Master Yuan is not here to see you."

    Aunt Liu glanced at him.

    "That doesn't stop him from being a bit human."

    Xie Wujiu put down the medicine spoon.

    "Jie Sha General."

    The black mist gathered into human shapes outside the palace, and the tall and powerful general knelt on one knee.

    "Follow me to Huaiyinpo."

    Aunt Liu picked up the bamboo basket.

    "I'll go too."

    Xie Wujiu frowned: "No need."

    "Why not? If you scare that little girl, someone has to put an end to it."

    Xie Wujiu: "..."

    Song Yan was very cautious and did not raise his head.

    In the end, Xie Wujiu just said coldly: "Slow down."

    Aunt Liu was satisfied.

    "I understand. Young master, when you see this girl, don't open your mouth to decide whether you want to die or kill her. You are not young anymore."
title_en: Chapter 5 The Living King of Hell is Angry
